This product is pretty terrible. I'm being generous with the 3 stars. I'm a professional nail tech and didn't feel like spending $40 each on a couple new sets of nippers, so I thought I'd give these a shot. First of all, the blade isn't sharp enough to cut, it's more grabbing and ripping than anything. Secondly, the tip is so unnecessarily sharp. There's no need for that, it just makes it easier to stab a client if you slip. I will not be purchasing again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the nippers sharp and effective, cutting cleanly and working as described.
Several reviewers report the blades are not sharp enough, grabbing or pulling cuticles instead of cutting them.
Reviewers frequently praise the value, calling it salon-quality or comparable to pricier brands at a low price.
Some reviewers note quality or alignment problems, including blades that don't meet properly or a different tip shape than pictured.
A few reviewers warn the tips are extremely sharp and pointy, requiring care to avoid injury.
